models_evaluated: gradient boosting trees model augmenting Braden Scale

links.outcome: HAPI events per 1000 census days and injury severity distribution on pilot vs control floors
links.effect: Significant shift from full-thickness PIs toward deep tissue injuries on pilot floors (OR 0.09; 95% CI 0.01-0.88; P=.03); HAPI census-day odds reduction not significant (OR 0.69; 95% CI 0.34-1.39; P=.38).
links.quote: A reduction in the odds of census days with HAPI events to those without was also observed but was not significant in the span of the pilot (odds ratio: 0.69; 95% CI, 0.34-1.39; P =.38).

screen.reason: This is a real-world clinical pilot evaluating the impact of deploying a predictive risk model in the EHR on hospital-acquired pressure injuries, testing the model intervention itself rather than comparing deployment practices/guardrails.
